--- create_change_stream_for_tables_named_schema.sql
CREATE CHANGE STREAM change_stream_name FOR sch.table_name1(column1, column2), table_name2
--- AST
&ast.CreateChangeStream{
  Name: &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 21,
    NameEnd: 39,
    Name:    "change_stream_name",
  },
  For: &ast.ChangeStreamForTables{
    For:    40,
    Tables: []*ast.ChangeStreamForTable{
      &ast.ChangeStreamForTable{
        Rparen:    76,
        TableName: &ast.Path{
          Idents: []*ast.Ident{
            &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 44,
              NameEnd: 47,
              Name:    "sch",
            },
            &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 48,
              NameEnd: 59,
              Name:    "table_name1",
            },
          },
        },
        Columns: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 60,
            NameEnd: 67,
            Name:    "column1",
          },
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 69,
            NameEnd: 76,
            Name:    "column2",
          },
        },
      },
      &ast.ChangeStreamForTable{
        Rparen:    -1,
        TableName: &ast.Path{
          Idents: []*ast.Ident{
            &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 79,
              NameEnd: 90,
              Name:    "table_name2",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE CHANGE STREAM change_stream_name FOR sch.table_name1(column1, column2), table_name2
